required_nodes.rationale: Authenticated and current causal-principal evidence issues an exact bounded allocation, records backend entry and an append-only receipt chain, then preserves the reduced entitlement on restart.
A proven pre-entry rejection restores exactly one provisional unit while backend entry makes restoration impossible.
Policy substitution, duplicate attempts, and exhaustion fail closed without double spending.
Callers cannot expand policy, use stale currentness, or mint an allocation identifier.
The standalone organ exposes no inference admission, model, serving, principal, policy-authoring, or grant power.
